heading: Apple as a Diversification Play Amidst AI Spending Concerns
tldr: Many US tech giants are investing heavily in AI, leading to significant capital expenditure and potential risks for investors.
Apple, in contrast, has maintained a lower capital expenditure of $6.8 billion while its stock rose 7%, offering a different profile.
This makes Apple an attractive option for Indian investors looking for tech exposure without heavy AI-related investment risk.
Investing in US stocks from India involves understanding the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) and tax implications, including Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAA).
Adding global companies like Apple to your portfolio can enhance diversification, reduce concentration risk, and offer exposure to different market dynamics.
caption:
Ever wonder if you can invest in top global companies from India? Many big US tech firms are spending a lot on AI, which can be risky. But Apple is different – it's grown well without huge AI spending. This could be a smart way for you to invest in tech without some of those bigger risks.
